reason: A client-side DeepSeek Harness web interface enhancement that adds a configurable animated particle-network background and stores its visual preferences in browser localStorage.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web 界面添加可配置的动态粒子网络背景，并在浏览器中保存视觉设置。
summaries.en: Adds a configurable animated particle-network background to the DeepSeek Harness web interface and saves visual preferences in the browser.

capabilities: renders an animated particle-network background in the web interface
provides adjustable visual settings for particles, lines, colors, and speed
persists visual settings in browser localStorage
